recommendations.title: Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)'
recommendations.description: This policy setting determines the number of unique new passwords that must be associated with a user account before an old password can be reused.
recommendations.rationale: The longer a user uses the same password, the greater the chance that an attacker can determine the password through brute force attacks.
recommendations.audit: Navigate to Computer Configuration\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account Policies\Password Policy and verify the value.
recommendations.remediation: Set Enforce password history to 24 or more password(s).

recommendations.title: Ensure 'Turn on Script Scanning' is set to 'Enabled'
recommendations.description: This setting controls script scanning in Microsoft Defender Antivirus.
recommendations.rationale: Script scanning helps detect malicious script activity.
recommendations.audit: Review Microsoft Defender Antivirus policy settings and confirm script scanning is enabled.
recommendations.remediation: Enable the policy setting in Group Policy.
